title: Identical rented units, numbered once
heading: An Ordering Row Keeps at Least One Copy of Every Plan and Removes the Rest
cases: with your rows the fewest units is unchanged, a plan numbered in order is allowed, and the same plan shifted to start at unit 1 is refused
a plan that rents unit 2 while unit 1 stays idle is refused
a plan that puts the first site on the second unit is refused
a plan numbered by first site whose unit 0 carries fewer days than unit 1 stays allowed
